name: Zakopane (Poland)
description: Divided horizontally blue over white by a jagged line in the outline of Mount Giewont, with the city arms on the summit towards the fly.
history: Polish gmina flags are established by resolution of the gmina council under the Act on Badges and Uniforms, normally after an opinion of the Heraldic Commission; the flag takes the colours of the arms.

features.role: division shaped as the outline of Giewont
